scope: Known development layout, post-budget diagnostic. A uses archived native commands. B checks the two-camera RGB-D point clouds for a floor-level slot that preserves the placed soup before changing a command. If there is no supported slot, B returns to A at the fork.
geometry_scope: Horizontal projected footprints with both cans supported at the same level. The Y centerline is the narrow axis known from this development layout; its position and current basket orientation must be estimated from RGB-D. Also score the full aperture with the Y restriction removed.
readouts: Track both official predicates, first and last simultaneous success, last 20 physical states released and in basket together, basket-floor/wall and can-can contacts, intervention/abstention and any regression of the placed soup. Follow the matched diagnostic horizon even after a transient predicate.
